Generate a deterministic qualitative color sequence

Source: R/palette-generate.R
sc_palette_generate.Rd

Extends an optional fixed set without changing its colors. Candidates are ranked by their worst CIE2000 separation under normal, deutan, protan, and tritan simulations. The result is diagnostic and is not a guarantee of universal color-vision-deficiency safety.

Usage

sc_palette_generate(
  n,
  seed_colors = character(),
  background = c("light", "dark")
)

Arguments

n

Number of colors.

seed_colors

Optional colors that must remain at the start.

background

Background for candidate scoring, "light" or "dark".

Value

A hexadecimal color vector.

Examples

sc_palette_generate(6, seed_colors = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00"))
#> [1] "#0072B2" "#D55E00" "#00DCC6" "#8B4D49" "#FFA270" "#BCADFF"
